contract: docs/v3/concepts/migration-release.md section 7 (scope, the trap table, replacement proof 1-4), section 3.2 (row schema: codemod 'imports', verify 'ast'); docs/v3/evidence/gap-migration-coexistence-and-consumer-testing.md Part 2 and section 2.1 (traps).

change: bun tools/migrate-v3/run.ts layout <app-dir> --report <file> rewrites Stack, Group, Flex, Center, Box, Text, SimpleGrid and their style props to classes, mapping type sizes by px not name (xs xs, sm sm, md md, lg base, xl lg), emitting font-normal for every Text, text-ellipsis for lineClamp, explicit Stack, Group and SimpleGrid defaults, refusing fw=semibold as a latent bug, and never the retired text-xl/[1.55] form. Style props on non-target components (a Button with mt) and responsive props go to the worklist with a reason: the report is a worklist, never an exemption. bun tools/migrate-v3/run.ts imports <app-dir> applies the pure-rename rows (codemod 'imports') from packages/basalt-ui/migrations/areas/*.json. run.ts leaves a dispatch table for bench|valueshifts|classes-exist|lint-clean that v3-mig-bench fills. Rule: none. Skill snippet: none. Test: one fixture per trap.
